info.title: Duta API
info.description: Transactional email for Malaysia. Every route also answers without the /v1 prefix, as Resend's do, so a Resend SDK works with only its base URL changed. Every response carries X-Request-Id.

apiKey.description: An API key from the dashboard, starting duta_

status.description: sent is a sandbox send, delivered at once

name.description: The Resend error name, so code that branches on it keeps working

code.description: Duta's error code, finer grained than name

request_id.description: Find this request on the Logs screen

archived.description: false when the content was not kept

token.description: The key. Shown once and never again

signing_secret.description: whsec_ secret for verifying deliveries. Shown once

counts.description: Messages by status over the last 30 days

post.description: Needs html or text. On the Free plan, or from a sandbox address, the mail goes through the sandbox. scheduled_at, template, topic_id are refused with 422 rather than ignored.

parameters.description: Repeat a request safely for 24 hours. A replay carries Idempotent-Replayed: true
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
